name: data-guard
description: TrueNorth's Data Guard: checks Claude Code prompts and tool output for customer data under organisation policy. /data-guard explains what it did and shows its status. Staff type /data-guard allow <why> to let one false alarm through, /data-guard test-data <file> <why> to vouch for a file of made-up data, or /data-guard off <why> to switch it off for one session. Forced on for the TrueNorth organisation.
